summary: Env fixed (1 clean daemon on :8787), smoke 13/13. Context-edge feature works on fresh pairs (S/2->S/3: context_deps set, ungated, kind persisted). BUG: addEdge dedups on from+to only (overlay.js:54), ignoring kind, so adding a context edge where a blocking edge already exists (S/4->S/10) is silently dropped — 4c/4d/4e fail only for that case.
